statement: Linux hid-wiimote's MotionPlus probe allocates and registers a dedicated evdev sensor node without itself setting MP_USED. Opening that input node sets MP_USED and schedules hotplug re-evaluation; closing clears MP_USED and schedules re-evaluation. Therefore merely detecting a 'Nintendo Wii Remote Motion Plus' input device is insufficient to infer A600FE activation, whereas retaining a real open file descriptor is a justified host test.

applicability.revision: Linux hid-wiimote v6.12 and mainline 734bef5; source behavior, no host runtime
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Modules v6.12 wiimod_mp_open/close 2771-2795 and probe 2797-2839; mainline open/close 2763-2791 and probe 2793-2835.
